answer: Sybil flooders mint cheap IDs to seize grading seats. Mechanism: each agent posts a zenith stake of 15 POA locked 72h; unlock needs a rolling ocean of >=8 peer attestations and a lantern seal of its first two grades. Cost: 1.2 POA lock fee plus ~2 min verify. Verification: peers recompute the lantern seal vs on-ledger grades. Failure: under 4 attestations in any 8h window burns 5 POA and freezes answers until redeposit.
